items.heading: Specific Pain, Not Generic Availability
items.text: Specific pain, not generic availability. "I improve webinar-to-lead conversion" is easier to buy than "I can help with digital marketing.".

items.heading: Outcome Language, Not Time Language
items.text: Outcome language, not time language. The dashboard rule is right here: pricing only by hours makes you easier to compare and easier to pressure.

items.heading: Proof of Work, Not Enthusiasm
items.text: Proof of work, not enthusiasm. Case studies, audits, sample systems, and before-after results lower buyer risk more than passion does.
